feat: Complete PRISM v0.14.6 - AI-Powered Product Management Platform

This major commit includes the complete implementation of PRISM, an enterprise-grade
AI-powered product management platform with the following key features and fixes:

## 🚀 Core Features
- Complete product management workflow (Organization → Project → PRD)
- AI-powered PRD generation using Claude 3 Sonnet
- User story generation with AI assistance
- Sprint planning and velocity analysis
- Real-time collaboration features
- Enterprise authentication with JWT tokens

## 🔧 Recent Fixes (v0.14.6)
- Fixed health checks causing unexpected AI API costs
  - Removed actual API calls from /health/detailed endpoint
  - Replaced with configuration-only validation
  - Added cost analysis documentation

## 🔧 Previous Fixes (v0.14.5)
- Fixed frontend timeout issue for AI PRD generation
  - Increased timeout from 30s to 120s for AI endpoints
  - Added endpoint-specific timeout configuration
  - Updated Kubernetes ingress for AI endpoints

## 🔧 Previous Fixes (v0.14.4)
- Fixed real AI integration for PRD generation
  - Created Anthropic and Ollama service implementations
  - Fixed environment variable loading in Docker
  - Updated Prometheus metrics to use .labels() method

## 📁 Project Structure
- Backend: FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy
- Frontend: Next.js 14 with shadcn/ui
- Database: PostgreSQL with Redis caching
- AI Services: Multi-provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama)
- Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes-ready

## 📚 Documentation
- Comprehensive CLAUDE.md with setup instructions
- Enterprise implementation guides
- AI configuration documentation
- Security and compliance docs
- Troubleshooting guides

## 🔒 Security
- Enterprise authentication with session persistence
- Rate limiting and DDoS protection
- Security headers and CSRF protection
- Audit logging and monitoring

## 🛠️ DevOps
- Complete CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions
- Security scanning (CodeQL, Trivy, Semgrep)
- Docker multi-stage builds
- Kubernetes manifests

This commit represents months of development work on creating a production-ready
AI-powered product management platform for enterprise use.
